## Summary

Add **Add to GitHub issue** to the filename dropdown for HTML and Markdown artifacts. Users can choose a repository and search by issue number or title, or paste an issue URL to select both. The dialog shows the destination before uploading the saved file through the signed-in GitHub CLI.

## Tested in Electron

The filename menu for a sample Markdown artifact

![Artifact filename dropdown with Add to GitHub issue](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/b8d9563f-3470-4eff-aaf6-ac5df6531a6b)

The issue picker with a matching result highlighted

![Open issue picker with a highlighted GitHub issue](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/0c1ede46-192e-4294-a32e-bbf718622443)

The confirmed selection with a link to the issue on GitHub

![Selected GitHub issue and enabled Add to issue button](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/b9f3178d-b186-40a4-815c-88e8c459217c)

## Verification

- Ran desktop and E2E TypeScript checks.
- Ran focused tests for the API boundary, filename menu, issue selection, pasted links, empty search results, and translations.
- Verified issue lookup in the native Electron app against GitHub. Automated tests exercised artifact creation with a simulated GitHub response.


<!-- This is an auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->
<!-- coderabbit-ai-generated:v1 -->

## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **New Features**
  * Add supported Markdown and HTML artifacts to GitHub issues from the artifact menu when you own the artifact and the session isn’t shared.
  * Search for issues, choose a repository and destination issue, or paste an issue link before publishing. Pull request links aren’t accepted.
  * Confirm before publishing the artifact’s full content, then open the issue or view the artifact on GitHub. If the upload outcome is unclear, check the issue before retrying.
  * The issue-publishing flow is available in multiple languages.
* **Bug Fixes**
  * Artifact previews from connected remote hosts now use the correct host connection.
<!-- end of auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->
title: Add HTML and Markdown artifacts to GitHub issues
